correctness.rationale: For every labelled 2<=a<=b<=c, abc triangle incidences force |D|>=ab, with equality requiring exact-one deleted edge in every triangle and equal maximal incidence multipliers. The nonbalanced cases follow vertexwise complementary binary choices; in the balanced case exact-one binary arrays force an A-, B-, or C-split and three pairwise pure-side overlaps. Direct Hamming distances show first nontrivial batch threshold b or n; cross-family exchange distance n(p+q)-pq>=2n-1 blocks extra edges. Three glued Q_n cubes have exact edge count and diameter floor(3n/2). Standalone complete finite tests cover 405579 candidate subsets and larger independent construction checks.

value.rationale: This establishes sharp batch-exchange connectivity thresholds and the exact optimum-state reconfiguration graph for a natural, well-studied triangle-cover problem. With the classical minimum-cover state space as input, the balanced case yields three Boolean cubes joined at antipodal corners and a nontrivial exact shortest-path diameter. This is independent structural mobility information, beyond the known cover size and vertex-cover parametrization.
